description: This file defines the `CashierTransactionData` class, a data transfer object (DTO) used to represent cashier transaction information within the Fineract organization’s teller module. It includes fields for transaction details, associated entities, and utility methods for creating instances.

classes.name: CashierTransactionData
classes.description: A serializable data transfer object encapsulating details of a cashier transaction, including identifiers, types, amounts, dates, related entity info, and metadata.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Creates a new `CashierTransactionData` object with provided transaction details, using chained setter methods.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Generates a template `CashierTransactionData` object with core information for further customization or use as a default.
